Package edu.bu.pas.hex

Class GameView

java.lang.Object
edu.bu.pas.hex.GameView
All Implemented Interfaces:
GenericGame, Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Game
public class GameView extends Object implements GenericGame, Serializable
An immutable version of an Hex game. Your main interactions will be through the interface.

This assignment splits game states into 2 separate classes, an immutable View and a mutable instance. The mutable instance is a subclass of the immutable view solely for ease of implementation. We will always pass you a deep copy of the mutable Game class, so you will not be able to modify the internal game state.

You can check whether your instance is mutable or immutable by using the following snippet: 


 GameView game = ...; // put your game object here
 if (game instanceof Game mutableGame) {
     System.out.println("yep, pretty mutable");
 }

In this game, there is an Owner enum used to distinguish who owns what squares. The enum value TEAM_A corresponds to player index 0 and the enum value TEAM_B corresponds to player index 1.

    • getTerminalUtility

      public Double getTerminalUtility(int playerIdx)
      A method to get the terminal utility of a player. In this game TEAM_A is player 0 and TEAM_B is player 1. This method will return null if this game is not terminal. A player is awarded +100 points if they win, -100 if they lose, and 0 if they tie.
      Specified by:
      getTerminalUtility in interface GenericGame
      Parameters:
      playerIdx - The index of the playe to get the terminal utility for.
      Returns:
      The terminal utility for that player. Will return null for nonterminal states.

    • isOver

      public final boolean isOver()
      Returns true if the game is over. A game is over if either Agent has accrued enough strikes (and therefore they lose), if either team has achieved their goal (connecting their two sides of the map with a contiguous path of tiles they own), or if no actions are left which is a tie.
      Specified by:
      isOver in interface GenericGame
      Returns:
      Whether the game has reached a terminal state.

    • getOutcome

      public final Owner getOutcome()
      Returns the outcome of the game if the game is over. If the game is over it will return Owner.TEAM_A if that team won, Owner.TEAM_B if that team won, and null on a tie. If the game is not over, it will return null so be sure to only call this method if you have previously checked that the game is over!
      Returns:
      The Owner enum corresponding to the winning team, null on a tie or if the game is not over.
